cohort: The study included 5663 consecutive women with a pre-gestational body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher who planned a trial of labor at a single tertiary medical center between 2012 and 2022.
finding: A predictive score model for intrapartum cesarean delivery was developed, demonstrating 85% sensitivity and 70% specificity, based on independent risk factors including maternal age >35, higher pre-gestational BMI, nulliparity, and various labor interventions.
mod_finding: A developed prediction score model can assist caregivers in providing informed consultations to women with obesity regarding their mode of delivery decisions.
